sentences.text:
ORDER Since in the miscellaneous appeal no one had appeared on behalf of the respondents though served,
therefore, on the prayer of counsel for the applicant, service on respondents is dispensed with.
This MCC has been filed for restoration of MA No. 3320/2012, which was dismissed for want of prosecution by order dated 29.01.2026 (Annexure A/1).

It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that the miscellaneous appeal was listed for hearing on 12.01.2026, however, the earlier counsel engaged by the applicant did not appear on the said date and due to non- appearance of the counsel, the appeal was dismissed for want of prosecution.
It is submitted that the application is within time.
The applicant is very much interested in prosecuting the appeal.
It is submitted that for the mistake of counsel, the litigant should not be made to suffer and hence, prayed for restoration of the miscellaneous appeal.

Considering the submissions of the counsel for the applicant, for the reasons mentioned in the application, which is supported by an affidavit, coupled with the fact that the miscellaneous appeal was filed under the provisions of Motor Vehicle Act for enhancement of the compensation, which is a beneficial legislation, the MCC is allowed.

MA No. 3320/2012 is restored to its original position subject to deposit of cost of Rs. 500/- with the M.P. High Court Employees' Association Jabalpur (Saving A/C No. 519302010000235, Union Bank of India, IFSC No. UBIN0551937, State Bar Council Building, High Court Compound, Jabalpur)
within a week from today.
